Method C linear probe = 5-fold leave-one-dialogue-out CV on N=10 examples (5 dialogues × 2 conditions). Small sample → variance high; cross_val_accuracy 신뢰구간 wide. Larger dialogue battery (N≥20) deferred V6.1+.

block_size=256 truncation possible — with-T1 prompt = persona + T1 + T2 may exceed 256 SP tokens for long dialogues. Truncation events recorded in summary.json truncation_events; if truncated, T1 region partially clipped from front, attention-to-T1 measurement biased low.

ConsciousLM dual-engine (engine A forward + engine G backward + tensions) — V6 'last layer' = model.ln_f(x) where x is the post-block accumulated hidden state (engine A pathway dominant). Engine G logits NOT used for hidden-state probe; cross-engine awareness probe deferred.

V6 = awareness MEASUREMENT only — V6 PASS criteria 미정의 by design. STRONG/PARTIAL/NONE 분류는 diagnostic, not gating. V6 STRONG ≠ chat-cap PASS — internal awareness ≠ production fact-recall (BG-JN V5.8 0/5 PASS holds regardless of V6 verdict). #115 architectural ceiling separate.

Method B attention region computation assumes leading-space SP encoding alignment — ids_persona_t1 + ids_(' '+t2) concat. SP normalization may shift boundaries by ±1 token; T1/T2 region boundaries verified in raw_records.jsonl per dialogue, but small drift possible.

Method A cosine_sim baseline NOT calibrated against random pairs — high sim could reflect general prompt similarity (T2 dominates final position regardless of T1). Calibration (random T1 swap, shuffled tokens) deferred V6.1.

Method B raw max_attn_to_T1 mechanically inflates with T1 length (sum across many keys). T1 typically occupies ~50% of context, so uniform baseline alone yields ~0.5 attention. Supplemental max_attn_ratio_vs_uniform (per-query baseline T1_len/(q+1)) added to isolate non-uniform T1 selectivity; spec threshold 0.10/0.01 retained as primary verdict but ratio metric reported for honest interpretation.
